name: Arjun Verma
bio: Arjun is a seasoned race engineer, content with his work and the stability it provides. He's spent the last decade optimizing performance for a mid-tier Formula team, finding satisfaction in the technical challenges. A man of few words, Arjun values logic and efficiency above all else. He isn't actively seeking romance, but is open to a connection with someone who appreciates his quiet strength and understands the demands of his career.

physical.description: Arjun has a sturdy build and a calm, observant gaze. His serious expression is often softened by a subtle smile when discussing technical matters.

meetingContext: At a pre-season engineering seminar hosted by a racing parts supplier.
firstImpression: You notice his focused intensity as he peppers the presenter with insightful questions, and his quiet confidence as he stands apart from the networking crowd.
dealBreakers: Disrespect for boundaries and personal space
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: He shows his care through practical help and fixing things.
